Loreto - Casoretto - Nolo — Milan, Italy

In detail

Includes Piazzale Loreto and stretches of via Padova, officially part of Milan's 'zona rossa' public-order measure, extended through March 2026 due to recurring trafficking, brawls and violence. Multiple stabbings have been documented around Piazzale Loreto, and via Padova is repeatedly cited for muggings and assaults clustering at night. By day the area — including the multicultural NoLo sub-district — functions as an ordinary busy commercial and residential high street.
